appName.description: Name of the MuleSoft application to resolve versions for. The connector menu is scoped to the connectors THIS app references (declared or inherited), with each one's current version populated.

repo.description: GitHub repository override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

owner.description: GitHub owner/org override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

appPath.description: Path to the Mule module within the repo (e.g. "." for repo root).

orgId.description: Anypoint organization ID override (registry/convention fallback otherwise).

branch.description: Explicit branch. Highest precedence over registry default / discovered default.

artifactIds.description: Further narrow the resolved menu to these connector artifactIds (on top of the app scope). Omit to return every connector the app references.

noFetch.description: Skip ALL network (Exchange + release-notes). Returns matrix-only choices (recommended pin only), still app-scoped and current-populated. Default false.
